title: Common sectionwise coefficient equivalence
statement: Let B be a topological commutative ring, let e identify its sheafified constant ring with its continuous-function condensed ring at the profinite point, monoidally. Fix an equivalence G from internal ULift B-modules in abelian groups to ordinary ULift B-modules with literal equality of the forgetful functors. On every scheme T, use this same G sectionwise, sheafify, and transport scalars along the ring isomorphism induced from e. The resulting explicitly constructed equivalence E_T goes from module-valued pro-etale sheaves to internal modules over the pulled-back condensed ring. Its functor preserves the underlying abelian sheaf up to the displayed natural isomorphism.

proof.text: Use the explicit sectionwise sheafEncoding, not a choice from its existence theorem.

Compose its inverse equivalence with the inverse of comap along the ring identification pulled back from the point. The underlying-sheaf isomorphism is the whiskered sheafEncodingForgetIso and its counit.
